checkedAlternates.risk: Balsamic and Chinkiang are both dark, sweet-tart aged vinegars.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Balsamic Vinegar of Modena is made from concentrated grape must (group-4), whereas Chinkiang is fermented from glutinous rice (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Distilled white vinegar is clear like Japanese rice vinegar.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Distilled white vinegar is made from purified distilled alcohol (group-1), not fermented rice (group-2).
